verdict.rationale: Figma has no native background automation or scheduled-agent feature. Plugins run only when a user invokes them, and the Figma agent is used interactively. Autonomous automations are possible only by building your own external service on Figma's primitives: webhooks that fire on file events (comments, new versions), plan access tokens meant for CI/CD and user-agnostic webhooks, and the REST and Variables APIs for CI integration. Missing for 10: a first-party automation or workflow builder, scheduled or unattended AI agent runs, background-executing plugins, and hands-on evidence of autonomous workflows.
